Messages.Author: donk
Messages.Body:
I've been playing with the idea of a deck that combines these cards:
1) Anarch Revolt - For offensive pool damage or to keep my own pool lower than my prey.
2) Parity Shift - For taking back pool I loose due to revolts.
3) Imperial Decree - For when you want others to regret going anarch to get around the revolts.

Vampires to use would probably be Hardestadt and Dmitra Ilyanova with freak drives and alastor for multirush and a fair amount of aillah's to get going before I'm already dead. Combat would have to be as many permanents as possible to make room for all other cards...

Anyone think it's doable or am I just too fond of to complex ideas?

Messages.Author: Ohlmann
Messages.Body:
Parity Shift is not playable by Haarderstadt, so something say me it won't work too well.

But, mainly, the problem is that multirush is way too complex to add a whole political / anarch revolt angle on top of it. Just slap some Alastor on Haarderstadt, you will find it already plenty complex.

If what you want is using anarch revolt and parity shift, do not use inner circle, but only prince and justicar, and use 2nd trad to catch the one who are tempted to go anarch.

Messages.Author: Boris The Blade
Messages.Body:
There is a problem with your base plan: Anarch Revolt causes the whole table to lose pool, so it does not help you play Parity Shift.

Besides the star of the the deck would probably be Alonso Petrodon for his built-in anti-anarch special.

Messages.Author: derjudge
Messages.Body:
May be, Camarilla Segregation is better than Imperial Decree in this kind of deck.

Judgment: Camarilla Segregation
Type: Action
Requires: prince,justicar
Cost: 1 blood
Requires a ready prince or justicar. +1 stealth action.
Put this card in play. Each Methuselah controlling a non-Camarilla vampire burns 1 pool during his or her untap phase. Any Methuselah may burn this card by burning a non-Camarilla vampire he or she controls during his or her master phase.
